contract_change_proposals.change: CCP-2: PursuitProfile gains configRef?: string (loads config/pursuit.race.json) and PursuitApi gains setRouteHint(edgeIds: readonly number[] | null) for the predicted race route.
contract_change_proposals.why: Roadblocks must go on the next 3 gates of a known route; the frozen PursuitProfile has no per-profile config or route input. Fallback: authored ScriptedBlocks plus velocity-based prediction.

contract_change_proposals.change: CCP-3: define PhysicsBackend.vehicle.read output layout (per wheel: inContact, contact point, normal, suspension length, ground-frame velocities, load) and an applyWheelForces path so the pure stepHandling output can be applied as impulses at contact points; M03a spike (U-RAC-1) picks controller-based or own castRay-based implementation.
contract_change_proposals.why: The custom tire/lateral-grip model needs per-wheel contact data and force application that the frozen vehicle.drive() surface does not expose.

contract_change_proposals.why: Cockpit/hood and XR cockpit views, roadster thrusters, nitro/exhaust VFX anchors and shader-based dent damage without extra render objects.
